fields.scheme: Payment scheme name. Informational only. Null if not given.
fields.rid: Registered Application Provider Identifier (RID), 5 bytes, hex.
fields.index: Certification Authority Public Key Index (EMV tag 8F), 1 byte, hex.
fields.checksum: CA Public Key Check Sum, SHA-1(rid || index || modulus || exponent), hex. Published by a source and verified.
fields.expires: Expiry date per EFTlab, ISO 8601. Null if not given.
